comments.author: Battousai
comments.body:
Once again the traders are being ripped off!

These are being ultraoverpriced!

I will try to draw a comparison:
Everyone needs SSIPS! But very few players do nanban! So the price of the SSIPs is probably high already since the demand is high:

People are complaining of the price of SSIPs being 20mil per 1.

1,000 NC makes 5 of them. So you are paying 100mil ducats(20mil*5) per 1,000 nc, which is 100,000 ducats per nc unit.

Following that value, a unit of Nanban Purveyor Certificate:
2,200/50=44NC

Converting that 44NC by the current converted value of nc obtained from the SSIPs market value:
44*100,000ducats=4,4mil ducats

So the logical price of a unit of this should be around 4mil.
